title: Practice 1: Verbs that take the genitive

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Они пытаются заискивать перед империалистами, чтобы достичь своих ___ (политические цели).
exercises.prompt: They are trying to cozy up to imperialist forces in order to achieve their political aims.
exercises.why: «достигнуть» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Have they made progress?
exercises.why: «добиваться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Эта компания достигла ___ (значительное увеличение) товарооборота в прошлом году.
exercises.prompt: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
exercises.why: «достигнуть» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ann has achieved her desired goal.
exercises.why: «достигнуть» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ты заслуживаешь ___ (поздравления).
exercises.why: «заслуживать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom's shirt was heavily creased and in need of a good ironing.
exercises.ru: Рубашка Тома была вся в складках и требовала ___.
exercises.why: «требовать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Думаю, нам следует придерживаться ___ (изначальный план).
exercises.prompt: I think we should stick to the original plan.
exercises.why: «придерживаться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is afraid of getting lung cancer.
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Давайте придерживаться ___ (план).
exercises.why: «придерживаться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I anticipated trouble.
exercises.why: «ожидать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том боится ___ (обязательства).
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He narrowly escaped being killed.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Бойся ___ (данайцы), дары приносящих.
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: In other words, reliability is impossible unless there is a natural warmth.
exercises.ru: Другими словами, без естественного тепла нельзя добиться ___.
exercises.why: «добиться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Всё что касается ___ (объектно-ориентированное программирование) связано с косвенной адресацией.
exercises.prompt: Object-oriented programming is all about indirection.
exercises.why: «касаться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We go to the cinema to be scared by watching horror movies.
exercises.ru: Мы идём в кино пугаться ___ ужасов.
exercises.why: «пугаться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том боится ___ (привидения).
exercises.why: «бояться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Hideo turned the steering wheel sharply to avoid the bicyclist.
exercises.ru: Хидео резко повернул руль, чтобы избежать ___.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Джефф и Мия отчаянно пытаются избежать ___ (развод).
exercises.prompt: Jeff and Mia are making a last ditch effort to avoid a divorce.
exercises.why: «избежать» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The United States is seeking extradition of Julian Assange.
exercises.why: «добиваться» takes the genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
